instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Ember is a boutique music rights and publishing company managing a substantial catalog of 5,000 songs across 200 songwriters and composers. We handle complex revenue streams including mechanical royalties, performance licensing, and sync deals for major TV and advertising properties. The company operates with tight margins, requiring rigorous operational efficiency to maintain profitability in a highly competitive media landscape.
answers.pastInitiatives: A junior engineer built an internal dashboard to visualize our order backlog, which the operations team found useful. However, this was an informal side project with no official support or maintenance plan. When that engineer left, the dashboard became unreliable and was eventually abandoned. We learned that good ideas need institutional backing to survive.
answers.strategicGoals: Cost reduction and process optimization are our dominant strategic priorities. Our industry is experiencing margin compression due to rising input costs and price-sensitive customers. We need to systematically identify and eliminate inefficiencies across procurement, production, logistics, and back-office functions. Every 1% of margin improvement directly impacts our ability to reinvest in growth.
answers.teamSize: Our team includes 3 backend developers, 1 frontend developer, and 1 QA engineer, managed by the CTO who also acts as product owner. We outsource UI/UX design to a freelance designer as needed. The team can handle incremental product improvements but struggles to carve out focused time for larger innovation bets without compromising current sprint commitments.
answers.additionalContext: We underwent a significant restructuring 6 months ago, consolidating 5 business units into 3 and reducing headcount by 12%. The remaining teams are stretched thin managing the same workload with fewer people. Morale has stabilized but is still recovering. Any innovation initiative must be achievable without adding burden to already-overloaded teams and should visibly improve their daily work experience.

opportunities.title: Automated Royalty Reconciliation Workflow
opportunities.rationale: Manual royalty tracking is a major time sink and source of human error. Implementing an incremental automation tool that integrates data feeds from streaming platforms can significantly improve accuracy and save operational hours without requiring massive re-engineering.

first_actions: Identify the top 3 manual reconciliation bottlenecks.
Map out a simple API integration plan for one major platform.
Develop a proof-of-concept (POC) script using existing developer resources.
resources_needed: Subscription fee for specific data access APIs ($1,000)
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduce manual reconciliation error rate by 20% within 4 months.
milestones: Full pilot implementation with top 5 streams (Month 4)

opportunities.title: Internal Operational Knowledge Base (Wiki)
opportunities.rationale: To combat the 'process' barrier, a formalized internal knowledge base could standardize procedures for sync licensing and rights clearance. This reduces reliance on tribal knowledge and speeds up onboarding while lowering operational friction.

first_actions: Identify core knowledge gaps across legal/ops teams.
Select and configure a low-code wiki platform (e.g., Confluence trial).
Assign ownership for content migration from existing shared drives.
execution_plan.success_metric: Decrease average time spent locating standard operating procedure (SOP) documents by 30%.
milestones: Pilot SOP adoption across one business unit (Month 5)

next_steps.action: Conduct a focused process audit targeting the most time-consuming manual tasks.
Present the 'Automated Royalty Reconciliation' POC to the formal committee for budget approval.

key_weaknesses: Lack of a documented, scalable innovation pipeline due to informal processes.
Severe time constraints preventing dedicated R&D efforts for non-critical initiatives.
Cultural resistance and lack of institutional memory surrounding the value of formal documentation and process adherence.
Low digital maturity requires focus on foundational efficiency before advanced AI implementations.
